description: Route a chat completion sub-task through SentioGate (using model "auto" or a pinned provider/model) or enqueue it on the background batch queue.

async_batch.description: When true, enqueues the request on the async batch queue (/v1/batch/enqueue) instead of waiting synchronously.

model.description: Model ID (default: "auto" for automatic cost/tier routing).

prompt.description: The user prompt or sub-task instruction to execute.

name: sentiogate_delegate_prompt
